title: gunnefftee
tagline: Multiplayer FPS game; custom gun mods are minted as NFTs on the NFT Marketplace; React.js Website; Unity game; ERC721 contracts; Deployed on Polygon Mumbai Testnet
description:
Most games today provide skins and mods of game objects but none of them are unique. 
Duplication of skins is a huge problem that games like CSGO faced. Their monetization model fell sharply post duplication.
Players spend a ton of money on skins, yet they do not get anything exclusive.
Our project provides custom gun modifications and skins. NFTs of gun models are minted, bought and sold on our web platform. These models are imported in our Unity game. The NFTs owned are unique and exclusive to the 
Modifications of guns are the different attachments of the gun (suppressor, stock, scope, etc.).
Custom gun mods and skins can be created and minted in the "Gun Lab" on our website which has an interactable 3D graphic to view the gun.
how_its_made:
Integrating smart contracts with the react website took longer than we thought.
Also, due to heavy traffic, transactions were delayed and also rejected since the estimated gas being passed was insufficent.
To tackle this, we tried using Biconomy, but there is no support for Vite apps with their SDK.
Internet connectivity was unstable which delayed things.
